fusions.name: Singled Out
fusions.desc: A strike that reaches an enemy up to 5 tiles away. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at full range.

fusions.name: Lidless Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps your gaze across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds and [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Tonic Stillness
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, then leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Unseen
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
